game.title: Age of Empires IV
game.blurb: Historical real-time strategy game, from Relic Entertainment and World's Edge, released 2021-10-28. RAWG average playtime: 4 hours. Genre: Strategy. Chapters follow the modes the Steam achievements show.

chapters.title: The Four Original Campaigns
chapters.summary: The Normans, The Hundred Years War, The Mongol Empire and The Rise of Moscow, with a feat for many missions.

chapters.title: The Sultans Ascend Campaign
chapters.summary: The Sultans Ascend campaign and its mission feats, such as the Red Sea, Egypt, Mansurah and Cyprus.

chapters.title: Historical Battles
chapters.summary: Agincourt, Safed, Montgisard, Towton, the Combat of the Thirty and Conqueror Mode.

chapters.title: The Yue Fei Campaign
chapters.summary: The Yue Fei campaign and its mission feats.

chapters.title: Tutorials, Masteries and Challenges
chapters.summary: The tutorial, Training and Civilization Masteries, Art of War challenges and the Crucible.

chapters.title: Skirmish, Victories and Customisation
chapters.summary: Beating the AI, Landmark, Sacred and Wonder victories, replays, portraits, monuments and your coat of arms.

chapters.title: Civilization Feats: English, French, Rus, Mongols and More
chapters.summary: Feats for the English, French, Holy Roman Empire, Rus, Mongols, Chinese, Abbasid Dynasty and Delhi Sultanate, plus naval, conversion and other match feats.

chapters.title: Civilization Feats: Ottomans, Malians, Byzantines, Japanese and More
chapters.summary: Feats further down the Steam list, for the Ottomans, Malians, Byzantines, Japanese, Knights Templar, House of Lancaster, Tughlaq Dynasty, Macedonian Dynasty, Sengoku Daimyo, Golden Horde and others.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Steam app 1466860 is now named "Age of Empires IV: Anniversary Edition"; it is the base game's store app. No StrategyWiki page under "Age of Empires IV" or "Age of Empires 4". ageofempires.fandom.com answers the API under "Age of Empires IV", with about 137 linked pages, including the campaign pages "The Normans", "The Hundred Years War", "The Mongol Empire", "The Rise of Moscow", "The Sultans Ascend (campaign)" and "Yue Fei's Legacy (campaign)", and civilization pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 175 Steam achievements is hidden. Strategy game, so chapters follow modes. Civilization feats are split in two by their place in the Steam list: achievements 45 to 85 cover the English, French, Holy Roman Empire, Rus, Mongols, Chinese, Abbasid Dynasty and Delhi Sultanate; achievements 90 onward cover the Ottomans, Malians, Byzantines, Japanese and later civilizations and variants (sorted by list position; masteries, campaign, battle and Crucible ones in that range stay in their own chapters). The Combat of the Thirty achievement does not say which mode it belongs to; it was put with the Historical Battles as a guess. Fandom links several Age of Empires IV expansion pages ("The Sultans Ascend", "Knights of Cross and Rose", "Dynasties of the East", "Yue Fei's Legacy"), but the data does not say which civilizations or battles each one adds.
